data.name: SyncLipSyncNode
data.description: Re-sync mouth movement in a video to new speech audio using sync.so. Handles close-ups, profiles and obstructions automatically while preserving the speaker's expression. Cost scales with output duration.

input_details.name: video
input_details.tooltip: Footage of the speaker to re-sync. Up to 4K (4096x2160); a constant frame rate of 24/25/30 fps works best.

input_details.name: audio
input_details.tooltip: Speech audio to sync the mouth to.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

input_details.name: model
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.sync_mode
input_details.tooltip: How to handle a duration mismatch between video and audio; this also sets the output length. bounce: video plays forward then backward until the audio ends (output = audio length). loop: video restarts until the audio ends (output = audio length). remap: video is time-stretched to match the audio (output = audio length). cut_off: the longer track is trimmed (output = shorter length). silence: nothing is trimmed; the shorter track is padded (output = longer length).

input_details.name: model.speaker_selection
input_details.tooltip: Which face to lipsync when several people are visible. default: let the model decide. auto-detect: detect and follow the active speaker. coordinates: target the face at pixel (speaker_x, speaker_y) in the frame chosen by speaker_frame.

input_details.name: model.speaker_frame
input_details.tooltip: Video frame used to locate the speaker. Only used when speaker_selection is 'coordinates'.

input_details.name: model.speaker_x
input_details.tooltip: X pixel coordinate of the speaker's face. Only used when speaker_selection is 'coordinates'.

input_details.name: model.speaker_y
input_details.tooltip: Y pixel coordinate of the speaker's face. Only used when speaker_selection is 'coordinates'.
